findings: Ordinance 2272 was signed and adopted January 21, 2026 with five ayes. It provides immediate effect, a 45-day term and explicit March 7 scheduled expiry unless extended; its interim scope is Saturn Park.

Ordinance 2274 was signed and adopted March 4, 2026 with five ayes. It provides immediate effect and citywide scope. Sections 4A/4D state 10 months and 15 days after adoption, while section 12 states January 21, 2027 expiry unless extended. Preserve those differing anchors without inferring an actual endpoint.

Retained Ordinance 2276 section 17 gives its provisions priority in a conflict; this does not expressly terminate every provision of 2272/2274. Earlier permanent-ban and election findings remain retained; no new ballot observation.
remaining_questions: Establish actual early termination or continued overlap of temporary Ordinances 2272/2274 after 2276/2279/Measure NDC, and any authority resolving the extension’s differing term anchors. Permanent-ban adoption alone does not establish an actual termination day.
